sentences.en: This seminar will target senior marketing leaders from Japanese firms.
sentences.zh: 这次研讨会将针对来自日本公司的资深市场营销领导者。

sentences.en: Senior executives spend a lot of time training their subordinates.
sentences.zh: 高层管理人员花了很多时间培训下属。

sentences.en: We look up to him as a good senior.
sentences.zh: 我们把他当作一位优秀的前辈尊敬他。

senses.zh: 上司；较年长者；毕业班学生
